component.name: Jones3D Portable
component.summary: Open source engine for Indiana Jones and the Infernal Machine

description.p: Jones3D Portable is a complete, open source reimplementation of the Jones3D engine of Indiana Jones and the Infernal Machine (1999). It replicates the original game experience — the same gameplay, menus, dialogs, save games and help — while running natively on modern systems.
The game data isn't included: on first start, it's installed from a Steam installation, the GOG offline installer or the original CDs.

ul.li: Vulkan and OpenGL ES 2.0 renderers, switchable in the display settings
Original dialogs and the CD launcher, recreated with native widgets
Built-in viewer for the game's WinHelp and HTML Help files
High resolutions and widescreen support, gamepads
Save games compatible with the original game

description.p: First release: native Linux and Windows builds with Vulkan, OpenGL ES 2.0 and Direct3D 11 renderers, the original dialogs and launcher, a game data installer and a built-in help viewer.
